model: WeatherMaker 48/50A2-A5 020-060 Rooftop (ComfortLink 8.x, UPC Open BACnet option)
applies_to: Carrier WeatherMaker 48/50A2, A3, A4 and A5 020-060 single-package large rooftop units with ComfortLink version 8.x controls and the UPC Open BACnet option.
summary: This is the ComfortLink 8.x generation of the 48/50A large rooftop. BACnet MS/TP comes from a UPC Open controller in its own enclosure below the main control box, which reads the ComfortLink board over CCN. The table has 268 rows (267 unique AV and BV IDs): occupancy, setpoints, air temperatures and pressures, building pressure, compressor relays, strikes and timeguards, economizer, demand levels, Humidi-MiZer, VAV and reheat settings, thermostat inputs, alarms and user-defined spare values.
default_device_instance: Network number 16101 followed by the MAC address (MAC 20 gives 1610120)
notes: Form 48/50A-13T (2-18) for ComfortLink 8.x units. The current 48/50A020-060 with ComfortLink 11.x (48-50A-17T) has a different list: only about 100 of these object IDs are shared.
Object names end in _1. Descriptions are the printed point descriptions, with the CCN point name added where two rows share a description.
The table prints BV:47 twice: Enable Compressor A2 (cmpa2ena_1) and HumidiMiZer 3-way Valve (Hum3wval_1). Only the first is kept here; check the live device.
Element Comm Status (BV 2999) and the user-defined values (AV 2901-2905, BV 2911-2915) print n/a in the read/write column; they are shown read-only here.
Units printed as °^F are shown as Δ°F (temperature differences). Ranges are left out because several print garbled in the PDF.
This is ComfortLink + UPC Open, not the SystemVu or SmartVu controls used on other Carrier rooftops.

source.title: Weathermaker 48/50A2,A3,A4,A5020-060 Single Package Large Rooftop Units with ComfortLink Version 8.x Controls - Controls, Start-Up, Operation, Service and Troubleshooting (Appendix E: UPC Open Controller Network Points List)

integration.summary: The BMS talks BACnet MS/TP to the UPC Open, which reads and writes the ComfortLink control over CCN. Set the CCN schedule number for the occupancy source you want, then write occupancy, setpoints and (for VAV) the supply air setpoint; read HVAC mode, temperatures and alarm state. Values the BMS feeds in (space, return or outdoor temperature, RH, CO2) are forces that clear if not refreshed.

minimum_points.name: sat_1
minimum_points.why: Supply air temperature leaving the fan

minimum_points.name: element_stat_1
minimum_points.why: UPC's CCN communication status with the unit

integration.enable: The unit ships with Local Machine Disable (Service Test > STOP, BV 59 unitstop_1) set to Yes; set it to No before the unit runs. Occupancy follows the ComfortLink CCN schedule number (Configuration > CCN > SC.OV > SCH.N): 0 = always occupied, 1 = local schedule (default), 65-99 = a CCN schedule; 2-64 are not used and are forced back to 1. The points list makes Occupied? (BV 2008) writable, but the manual does not describe how a write interacts with SCH.N; test it on site. Emergency stop (BV 45) is forced over CCN.
integration.heartbeat: The manual says forces at CCN priority 7 clear unless rewritten in time: outside air temperature, outside RH, outside air quality and static pressure reset after 30 minutes, return air and space temperature after 3 minutes.
integration.remote_sensors: Space Temperature (AV 137), Return Air Temperature (AV 135), Outside Air Temperature (AV 1003), Outside Air RH (AV 119), IAQ (AV 1009) and OAQ (AV 113) are writable. Refresh them within the force timeouts (3 min for space and return temperature, 30 min for outdoor values).
setup: Set the MAC address on the UPC Open's Tens and Ones rotary switches; the controller reads switches, DIP switches and jumpers only at power-up.
Device instance = network number (default 16101) followed by the MAC address, e.g. MAC 20 gives 1610120.
BAS port: DS3 enable, DS4 E1-485, DS5-DS8 set to MSTP; baud on DS1-DS2 (9600, 19.2k, 38.4k or 76.8k, Carrier default 76.8k); 8N1 fixed. EIA-485 jumpers to EIA-485 and 2W.
Fit a BT485 terminator on the first and last controller of the MS/TP segment.
The UPC Open and the ComfortLink board must use the same CCN element and bus numbers (factory 1 and 0).
gotchas: Points depend on unit options (heat type, economizer, Humidi-MiZer, VFDs, building pressure control); objects for options not fitted carry no useful data.
BV 47 is printed for two different points in the table.
The user-defined analog and binary values are spare objects with no unit function.

note: Provided as-is. Point availability varies by firmware and options; verify against the live device.
